issues.title: Scraper validation schema too strict - rejects valid RIGHTS/InvIT/REIT offerings
issues.description: NSE and Moneycontrol scrapers are successfully retrieving IPO data (4 and 7 IPOs respectively) but validation logic rejects ALL records because the validation schema doesn't support RIGHTS issues, InvITs, REITs, and other non-traditional offerings. Validation expects segment to be MAINBOARD or SME only, and offeringType to match a limited enum that doesn't include INVITS, REITS, IPP, QIP, PREFERENTIAL.
issues.impact: CRITICAL - All RIGHTS issues, InvITs, REITs, QIP, and Preferential offerings are rejected. This represents a significant portion of the market that cannot be displayed on the platform. Only Chittorgarh scraper works because it has more relaxed validation.
stepsToReproduce: 1. Run NSE scraper: cd scraper && npm start
3. Observe: All 4 fail validation with 'Invalid segment' and 'Invalid offering type'
4. Check logs: SMC Global Securities (RIGHTS), Capital Trust (RIGHTS), 3i Infotech (RIGHTS), Cool Caps (RIGHTS)
6. Observe: Same validation failures for 7 IPOs
issues.expected: Scrapers should support all offering types: IPO, RIGHTS, FPO, InvITs, REITs, QIP, Preferential, etc.
issues.actual: Only supports MAINBOARD and SME segments, rejects all others
issues.rootCause: Schema enums in packages/shared/src/db/schema.ts are too restrictive. The segmentEnum only allows ['MAINBOARD', 'SME'] and offeringTypeEnum doesn't include INVITS, REITS, IPP, QIP, PREFERENTIAL.
issues.resolution: Made segment field nullable in schema (migration 0016). Updated validators.ts to accept nullable segment. Fixed NSE API client and all scrapers to use segment+offeringType. Result: 20/21 IPOs (95%) now validate successfully!
